name: GitHub Security Advisory Ingestion Errors
description: Generates an alert when GitHub security advisory ingestion produces documents with error fields. Collection errors come from failed GitHub API requests made by the Elastic Agent CEL input; pipeline errors come from failed ingest pipeline processors. One alert is raised per error kind, with the error count, affected advisory streams, error codes, and sample messages.
query:
FROM logs-github.security_advisories-default
| WHERE error.code IS NOT NULL OR error.message IS NOT NULL
| EVAL all_tags = MV_CONCAT(tags, ","),
       advisory_ingestion.error_kind = CASE(event.kind == "pipeline_error", "pipeline", "collection"),
       stream = CASE(all_tags LIKE "*github-security-advisories-reviewed*", "reviewed", all_tags LIKE "*github-security-advisories-unreviewed*", "unreviewed", all_tags LIKE "*github-security-advisories-malware*", "malware", "unknown"),
       message = SUBSTRING(MV_CONCAT(error.message, "; "), 1, 300)
| STATS advisory_ingestion.error_count = COUNT(*), codes = VALUES(error.code), messages = VALUES(message), streams = VALUES(stream) BY advisory_ingestion.error_kind
| EVAL advisory_ingestion.error_codes = MV_CONCAT(codes, ", "),
       advisory_ingestion.error_messages = MV_CONCAT(MV_SLICE(messages, 0, 2), "\n"),
       advisory_ingestion.streams = MV_CONCAT(streams, ", ")
| KEEP advisory_ingestion.*
false_positives: Transient GitHub API failures such as rate limiting (403/429) or 5xx responses can recover on the next 24-hour poll without intervention.
note:
## Triage and analysis

- `collection` errors are GitHub API responses other than HTTP 200. Check `advisory_ingestion.error_codes`: 401/403 usually mean an invalid or rate-limited `GITHUB_SECURITY_ADVISORIES_API_KEY`, 5xx is a GitHub outage. The failed poll resumes at the next 24-hour interval or on Agent restart.
- `pipeline` errors mean an ingest processor failed. The original event is kept; search `logs-github.security_advisories-default` for `event.kind: pipeline_error` and compare the document with the GitHub package version.

Alerts are grouped per error kind and suppressed per kind for 2 hours, covering the 10-minute lookback overlap.
setup: Requires the `github_security_advisories` standalone configuration from this repository, which tags each advisory stream with `github-security-advisories-<type>` and maps `error.*`, `event.kind`, and `tags` through the `logs-github.security_advisories@custom` component template.
